name: Unstack
description: The first clip is a stack of horizontal bands with the second clip stacked on top of it, out of frame: bands are yanked out sideways one at a time in a shuffled order, and each time everything above drops into the gap with a small bounce, so the second clip comes down into the frame in beats. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: bands
params.description: Number of bands in the first clip

params.name: bounce
params.description: Height of the bounce after each drop

params.name: slot
params.description: Color of the slot left empty by a pulled band
